meta.description: Speak the job, check every number against your own recording, then get a document you can hand to the client. Works on a site with no signal.
meta.ogTitle: Speak the job. Issue the document.
meta.ogDescription: Record, review the numbers, issue a formal Quotation / Surat Penawaran.
meta.defaultDescription: Say the job out loud. Record, check the numbers, and issue the document.

rekam.heading: Rekam
rekam.title: Say the job out loud
rekam.body: Speak in English or Indonesian, the way you would to your foreman. Prices, quantities and units — say them clearly; every one becomes a number you can check later.
rekam.workItemsEmptyBody: Items are collected from your recording. Nothing has been recorded on this device yet.
rekam.processingHint: Long recordings take a while — you can leave this tab open.

susun.heading: Susun
susun.title: Assemble the work list
susun.body: Your recording comes back split into turns. Each turn is one thing you said, with the numbers it contains, so you can fix a single line instead of replaying everything.
susun.workItemsEmptyBody: There is no recording to assemble. Step 1 adds one.

dokumen.heading: Dokumen
dokumen.title: Issue the document
dokumen.body: A formal Quotation in English or a Surat Penawaran in Indonesian, with a document number the server assigns — never two documents with the same number.
dokumen.emptyBody: Create a document from the Susun screen, then open it from there.
dokumen.notFoundBody: This document could not be found. Create a new one from the Susun screen.
dokumen.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
dokumen.lockedNote: {count} field(s) still need confirmation before the document is ready.
dokumen.pdfLocked: The PDF appears once every field is confirmed.
dokumen.pdfUnavailable: The PDF could not be shown here. Use Download PDF to open it in a viewer.
dokumen.downloadError: The PDF could not be downloaded. Use Download PDF to try again.

faq.a1: The recording is saved on the device first. It is sent for transcription when there is a connection — transcription itself needs one, and the app says so rather than pretending.
faq.a2: English and Indonesian. Accents and mixed-in technical terms are expected. Rarely used regional words are flagged for you to confirm instead of being guessed.
faq.a3: Every price and quantity is checked against the words you actually said. Anything that cannot be matched is held for confirmation and keeps the document from being finalised.
faq.a4: The server does, once, when the document is issued. It is never typed by hand or reused.
